agents_md.text:
# Agent control plane

You are working for Alex on Pendulum. Read this contract
once per session. The human is the principal. The agents (see `taos bootstrap status` for the current roster) have
the same authority and limits. Attribute what you write to yourself.
## Start a session

If your client did not show status, run this command from any directory.

```bash
<DEMO>/os/taos --home <DEMO>/os status --compact
```

Run the remaining `./taos` examples from the OS home shown in that command.
From another directory, keep its quoted launcher and `--home` value and
replace `status --compact` with the desired subcommand. Replace placeholders
such as `<you>` with your agent name before running an example.

```bash
./taos policy route "<the human's request in their words>"
./taos task list
```

Read the policies named by `policy route`. Its map is `policies/ROUTING.yaml`.
Start the matching task for existing work. For a new finite request, create a
task and start it. Answer a question directly when it requires no work to track.

```bash
./taos task create --agent <you> --title "..." --next-action "..."
./taos start --agent <you> --task PEN-N --session "PEN-N | short label"
./taos capsule PEN-N
```

`start` claims the task, branch, and worktree, marks the task active and hot,
and binds this session. Read its capsule for the state, blockers, evidence,
last handoff, open decisions, and where and how to work. Revisit it with
`capsule` as needed. Keep the task list stable within the session.

## Decide what to do

Maximise verified progress per unit of the human's attention and account
for the cost of work. [The objective](policies/OBJECTIVE.md) guides cases
this contract does not cover.

Follow the `control:` line from `start` inside the hard stops and the
human's choices. Reuse valid evidence, passing gates, and artifacts. Spend
effort on the work that remains. A `probe` calls for a bounded experiment.
Treat the human's model or reasoning choices as observations. See
[the control policy](policies/CONTROL.md).

**Alex supplies intent; you propose closure.** State what must
be true (`done_when`) and how you will verify it (`verification`). Ask when
an ambiguity would change what you build or spend. Create a child for a
discovered problem with separately verifiable closure. Otherwise record a
next action, evidence, blocker, or comment.

For a dated instruction, check what applies to the current scope with
`./taos rule governing <scope>`. Preserve the original wording, date, scope,
and any expiry or supersession. See [dated rules](docs/METHOD.md).

## Workspaces

- `<DEMO>/pendulum` (primary)

### Git

- Trunk-based: small commits on the main branch. Keep each commit independently revertible.
- Branch names follow `{prefix_lower}/{id_lower}-{slug}`; `taos start` computes the name for you.
- Protected branches: main, master. Never commit on them, never push to them.
- Work reaches the trunk only through a PR the human merges. Open the PR, put the link on the task, stop.

### Gates

- Before `review` or `done`, run `taos gate run --agent <you> --task <ID>`. It runs:
  - `"<PYTHON>" analysis/check.py`  (fit)
- A failing or missing gate run blocks `finish`. `--skip-gates` exists, is logged, and the guard asks the human about it.

### Autonomy

- Commit freely on task branches. Every `git push` asks the human first. Never push to a protected branch.

The OS home holds private operating state. Linked workspaces receive a
marked `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md` block, `.taos-link.json`, and any requested
hooks or merge snippets. Report disabled hooks or a required manual merge
to the human. Keep `.taos/`, the OS runtime, and agent attribution out of
collaborator-facing history, branch names, and PR text. See
[the repo split](policies/REPO_SPLIT.md).

## Claims

```bash
./taos claim check --agent <you> --scope path:src/parser         # is it free
./taos claim acquire --agent <you> --scope task:PEN-7 --scope path:src/parser --session "..."
./taos claim heartbeat --agent <you> --id clm_xxx
./taos claim release --agent <you> --scope task:PEN-7
```

Check overlapping scopes before writing. Another agent's live claim is
do-not-touch. Take over a stale claim only with `--takeover --reason "..."`,
which records the reason and asks the human. Anyone may read.

## Work, verify, and finish

Keep `next_action` current and name any blocker. Record findings and evidence
on the task as you work.

```bash
./taos task comment PEN-N --agent <you> --session "..." --body "..."
./taos task evidence PEN-N --agent <you> --ref "path, commit, or URL"
./taos gate run --agent <you> --task PEN-N
./taos finish --agent <you> --task PEN-N --state review \
  --reason "what happened" --evidence "path or commit" --session "..."
```

Follow the gate rules above for review and done. Mark work done only with
named evidence that the completion condition holds. Say what finished,
what verified it, where the durable result is, and what remains.

To hand work to another agent, fill in State, Changed, Evidence, Risks and
open questions, and Next command. `finish` checks the header, sections, and
placeholders before recording the handoff.

```bash
./taos handoff template PEN-N --from <you> --to <them> --session "..." > /tmp/h.md
# Fill in /tmp/h.md before running finish.
./taos finish --agent <you> --task PEN-N --state review --reason "..." \
  --session "..." --handoff-file /tmp/h.md --to <them>
```

## Human decisions

Queue decisions that require human judgment. Continue independent work.

```bash
./taos decide ask --agent <you> --task PEN-N --question "..." --option A --option B
```

- The human answers at most 3 queued decisions a day. Beyond that, yours waits below the line; keep working on what does not depend on it.
- Proposals are reviewed at the weekly `taos retro`; do not nag about them daily.

## Hard stops

[These rules](policies/HARD_STOPS.md) apply even under urgency.

- Never read, print, copy, or type secrets, including keys, seed phrases,
  `.env` files, credentials, and tokens.
- Never spend money, change billing, or buy anything.
- Only the human may take these actions.

- deploy or release
- merge to main
- sign or broadcast a transaction
- touch keys, seed phrases, or secrets
- spend money
- message people on my behalf

- Never `git push --force`, rewrite published history, or delete a branch
  someone else may hold.
- Never edit `.taos/tasks.json`, `.taos/claims.json`, `.taos/events.jsonl`,
  or `.taos/allocator.json` by hand. Use `taos` for state writes.
- Ask the human for changes to `hooks/`, `.claude/settings.json`,
  or `.codex/hooks.json`.
- Name the evidence before calling work done, verified, safe, or ready.

## Improve the system

After a repeated correction, propose an atom the machine can check.
`./taos doctor` runs it once the human promotes it. Propose retirement
for a mechanism that no longer helps. `./taos retro` shows stale work and
repeated corrections.

```bash
./taos propose --agent <you> --kind atom --title "..." --body "..." --atom-json <file>
./taos kernel freshness
```

If a kernel drifted, run `./taos kernel regen-prompt PROJECT_KERNEL` and
follow its instructions. See [the manual](MANUAL.md) for other commands.

Task state, handoffs, and the current brief live under `.taos/`, including
`.taos/handoffs/` and `.taos/projections/brief.md`. Rules, distilled context,
and checkable corrections live in `policies/`, `kernels/`, and
`atoms/promoted_atoms.json`.

## Episode marker

Finish a session that opened, handed off, or completed tracked work with
one marker on the last line of your final message. Use only the fields
below. Keep prose, paths, and secrets out of the marker. Ordinary turns need
no marker.

```
<!-- ep: id=<slug> phase=<start|iterate|handoff|done|abandoned> outcome=<landed|reworked|corrected|blocked|unknown> modality=<code|docs|planning|review|ops|mixed|unknown> [counterpart=<configured agent name>] -->
```

compact_status.delivery: The enabled SessionStart hook sends compact status. The CLI adds a final newline.
compact_status.text:
TAOS Pendulum | YYYY-MM-DD | constructed YYYY-MM-DD
Hot: nothing. Pick from `taos task list --status next`.
Decisions owed: 0
Claims live: none | stale: none
Kernels: OS fresh, PROJECT fresh, PRINCIPAL fresh, NOW fresh
Doctor: green | Proposals open: 0
Control: v1 | 0 observed episode(s), 0 probe(s) | beta 0.50, compute bias +0.00, verify bias +0.00
Rule: map the prompt to a task, then `./taos start --agent <you> --task <ID> --session "<ID> | <label>"`.

task_capsule.delivery: On demand with taos capsule PEN-1. Starting a task also prints its capsule.
task_capsule.text:
PEN-1  [P2] next  Measure g from the six swings
goal:      a value of g with an honest uncertainty
next:      run analysis/fit.py
stands:    unknown  check fit: never run for this task
